usecase.name: Monitor Bus Route and Notify Admin on Route Deviation
usecase.scenario: The system automatically monitors bus locations in real-time, and if a bus is detected on an incorrect route, a notification is immediately sent to the admin.
preconditions: Bus tracking system API is operational
Bus route data is predefined and configured in the system
steps: System continuously monitors the live location of each bus.
System compares the bus's current location with its predefined route.
If a bus is detected outside its assigned route, the system flags this as a deviation.
System sends an immediate notification to the admin, including the bus ID, current location, and timestamp of the deviation.
postconditions: Admin is notified of the route deviation in real-time.
The admin takes corrective action as needed.

testcases.description: Verify that the system continuously monitors bus locations in real-time and checks for deviations at regular intervals.

expected.message: System monitors each bus location in real-time without interruptions
